ops.body: Superseded by events: the migration this task tracked was implemented independently by the concurrent framework session and landed on origin/main as 139f65d7 ('feat!: migrate to cc-transcript v14.6 async persistence — ReviewStore composition, async review subsystem', 2026-07-19). ReviewStore now composes over cc_transcript.mining.store.FeedbackStore async-natively; pin is >=14.6.1,<15. Upstream kept the async direction: v14.6.1 only serialized judge.run_verdicts persist on a lock (TransactionConflictError fix) — no sync facade returned. One residue that commit left: uv.lock was not re-resolved (still resolves 14.4.0 with specifier >=14.4,<14.5); the fix-the-primitive wave's ship includes the re-lock to 14.6.1.
